description: This file defines the internal class 'DuplexPipe' which implements the 'IDuplexPipe' interface, managing paired input and output pipes for network data transmission within the Orleans networking library. It includes methods to create a connection pair of duplex pipes with specified options, and a nested struct 'DuplexPipePair' to hold the pair of pipes.

classes.name: DuplexPipe
classes.description: Internal class implementing IDuplexPipe, managing paired PipeReader and PipeWriter for duplex communication.

methods.name: DuplexPipe
methods.description: Constructor initializing 'Input' and 'Output' with provided PipeReader and PipeWriter.

methods.name: CreateConnectionPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of DuplexPipe instances with specified input and output PipeOptions, returning a DuplexPipePair.
